binary_scope: Exact binaries used for the native callback acceptance. Later candidate changes and measurements are recorded separately; this is not a claim that the complete final binary ran all acceptance steps.
environment: Windows x64 Steam, isolated owned profile and copied test world

controlled_checks.native_session_roles: Standalone, Host, Client, Unknown, stale epoch, provider errors and inactive/retained bridge are covered by controlled native fixtures.
controlled_checks.ownership: Original-once, nesting, retirement, worker rejection and zero-subscriber Runtime lifetime are covered by controlled native fixtures.

scope: api.time.set mediates Framework requests. It is not a native Clock detour. This record does not establish two-account multiplayer compatibility or native memory isolation.
